gloss: to meddle; to interfere; to butt in; to stick one's nose into

definitions.gloss: to meddle; to interfere; to butt in; to stick one's nose into
definitions.explanation: to meddle; to interfere; to butt in; to stick one's nose into

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口出|くちだ}しするな。
examples.english: Don't meddle in other people's business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交友|こうゆう}{関係|かんけい}→交友関係：24140_kouyuukankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口出|くちだ}しする。
examples.english: Parents always meddle in their children's friendships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧こと⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{口出|くちだ}ししてくる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧にくい。
examples.english: My boss interferes with every little detail, which makes it hard to work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧な⟦{口出|くちだ}し→口出し：21078_kuchidashi⟧はしないでほしい。
examples.english: I wish you wouldn't butt in with unnecessary comments.

notes:
Describes uninvited interference in someone else's affairs or decisions. Almost always carries a negative nuance — the speaker views the intervention as unwelcome or overstepping boundaries. Composed of ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out).

USAGE:
- Often used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark what is being meddled in: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口出|くちだ}しする
- The noun form ⟦{口出|くちだ}し→口出し：21078_kuchidashi⟧ is also common: ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧な⟦{口出|くちだ}し→口出し：21078_kuchidashi⟧ (unnecessary meddling)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧な⟦{口出|くちだ}し→口出し：21078_kuchidashi⟧: unnecessary meddling
- {口出|くちだ}しするな: don't interfere
- いちいち{口出|くちだ}しする: meddle in every little thing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{干渉|かんしょう}する→干渉する：21453_kanshousuru⟧: to interfere — a more formal term, often used in political or institutional contexts
- おせっかい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to be nosy; to be a busybody — focuses on offering unwanted help or advice
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む→突っ込む：07000_tsukkomu⟧: to stick one's nose into — a more colloquial, vivid expression for meddling
